$comment: Curated CC0 sources. 'scope' = 'whole-library' when every item at the source is CC0; 'filter-only' when the source mixes licenses and only items carrying a CC0 label qualify. 'searchable' = this repo's MCP server can search it directly. 'verified' = date and evidence this entry was last checked against the source's own license page or API.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.notes: API requires a User-Agent naming your app and a 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit when showing live API content. Downloaded assets need no attribution.

verified.evidence: license page meta: 'CC0 means absolute freedom.'; polyhaven.com/llms.txt: 'every asset is CC0'

sources.name: Openverse
sources.notes: Meta-search over Flickr, Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, museums and more. Only items whose own license field is 'cc0' qualify. Public Domain Mark ('pdm') items are excluded.

verified.evidence: API item field license="cc0" with license_url creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.notes: PBR materials, HDRIs and models. Has its own JSON API (ambientcg.com/api/v2/full_json).

verified.evidence: docs.ambientcg.com/license links CC0 1.0 for all assets

sources.name: Kenney
sources.notes: 2D/3D game asset packs, UI kits and sound effects. CC0 covers the assets on the asset pages.

verified.evidence: kenney.nl/support: 'the asset pages are public domain licensed (CC0)'

sources.name: Freesound (CC0 filter)
sources.notes: Mixed licenses. Use the 'Creative Commons 0' license filter. Many CC0 Freesound items are also reachable through Openverse search.

verified.evidence: Openverse returns freesound items with license="cc0"

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons — Category:CC-Zero
sources.notes: Mixed licenses across Commons. Files in this category carry a CC0 tag; check each file page.

excluded.name: Unsplash
excluded.reason: Uses the Unsplash License, not CC0.

excluded.name: Pixabay
excluded.reason: Uses the Pixabay Content License, not CC0.

excluded.name: Pexels
excluded.reason: Uses the Pexels License, not CC0.

excluded.name: Quaternius
excluded.reason: Not machine-verified: license text is rendered by JavaScript. Add it after a manual check.
